ruled_substitutions: Plain 'ground beef' is booked as 80/20 (ground-beef-8020, 7 of 7 stores, cheapest Sam's $4.77/lb, every cell a true 80/20 product) with the NEW USDA 80/20 DB row. This is the generic retail default AND the class the source's own numbers describe: their published fat (37 g) reproduces at 80/20 (ours 38.6) and would collapse to ~19 g at 93/7. Booking the house 93/7 row instead would deflate the dish to ~368 cal - under the 400 floor - misdescribing the recipe as published (Sour Cream full-fat precedent: deflation fails a floor gate as surely as inflation fails the ceiling). The source drains the browned fat; the raw-label basis therefore overstates fat somewhat, per house convention, noted not modeled.

macro_cross_check.verdict: EXPLAINED, NOT A PORTION ERROR - the protein gap exceeds 15% so the main protein line was re-examined per rule 6. Our side is weight-anchored by the source itself (1 lb / 3 servings = 151.2 g raw beef per serving), so no each-weight assumption exists to correct. Their 50 g protein is physically impossible for the stated ingredients: 151.2 g of even the LEANEST retail beef (93/7) yields 32.1 g, plus 6.1 g from the cheese = 38.2 g absolute ceiling. Their macro set is internally consistent (4x50 + 9x37 + 4x11 = 577 = their 576), which means their calculator booked a beef entry near 29 P per 100 g RAW-weight - that is cooked-beef protein density applied to a raw portion, a raw/cooked double-count on their side. Removing the phantom ~17 g protein (~68 cal) reconciles their 576 to our 525 within 1%. Fat corroborates the 80/20 ruling: theirs 37 vs ours 38.6 (+4%); at 93/7 fat would read ~19 (-49%), so their own label rules OUT lean beef.
macro_cross_check.band_check: computed 525.3 cal in [400, 650] PASS; carbs 8.6 g <= 35 PASS. With the house 93/7 row instead the dish computes 368 cal and FAILS the floor - the 80/20 ruling is load-bearing, see ruled_substitutions.

loud_flags: Source's published protein (50 g) is arithmetically impossible for its own ingredient list (ceiling 38.2 g); documented in the cross-check as a source-side raw/cooked double-count. Our 32.9 g is the defensible figure.

The 80/20-vs-93/7 choice decides the calorie floor for this recipe (525 PASS vs 368 FAIL). Ruled per the evidence in ruled_substitutions; if the house later prefers lean here, the recipe cannot pass the band as a 3-serving-per-pound dish.
board_defects_observed: Bare term 'ground beef' resolves to NO commodity (CAPTURE, 25 candidates across 2 stores) even though ground-beef-8020 and ground-beef-93-7 both exist with full cells; a generic include for the unqualified term would spare every future mapper this detour - flagged for the match-soundness gate.
